name: node-ts
description: TypeScript on Node: npm workspaces, Jest with Istanbul coverage, ESLint, Prettier, tsc, Cypress.

package-manager.fills: npm workspaces: `npm ci` installs, package-lock.json is the lock file, the workspaces are the packages

coverage-packages.fills: the npm workspaces that carry a coverage gate (coveragePackages of the profile file)

test-runner.fills: Jest: `npm test` and `npm run test:coverage`, per workspace with `-w <package>`

e2e-runner.fills: Cypress, run by the project's `e2e` command

coverage-tool.fills: Istanbul through Jest; the neutral summary is coverage/coverage-summary.json per package (`json-summary`)

coverage-merge.fills: adds the hit counts of the shards' coverage-final.json and writes the neutral summary

formatter.fills: Prettier, run from the project's installation only: `npx --no-install prettier`

version-file.fills: package.json, the `version` field (release.versionFiles of the profile file)

local-gate-plan.fills: typecheck, lint and format of the touched packages, Jest tests related to the changed files, the whole package for a change that cannot be followed, the changed-file coverage

ci-job-layout.fills: a static job and a coverage job per package, which keep the coverage for the aggregator

commands.fills: npm run lint, typecheck, test, test:coverage, format and the project's own scripts (the commands of the profile file)

ignore-files.fills: the Prettier ignore file, and the ESLint one when the project has it at its root; both exclude the vendored framework

scaffold-files.fills: `.nvmrc`, `.prettierignore` (excluding the vendored framework), a `package.json` whose `prepare` script installs the Git hooks, an empty `package-lock.json`, and the ignore lines of its tools

enforces.by: the pre-push gate holds the changed files whose related tests ran (`harness coverage check-changed`)
CI merges the coverage of the shards and holds each package and every changed file to the gate
CI runs the tests of every package
lint and typecheck of the touched packages in the pre-push gate
lint of the touched packages in the pre-push gate
